method.baseline: Risk Pressure = 3 × (Class C, immediately hazardous) + 1 × (Class B, hazardous) HPD violations issued in the trailing quarter (May 2026–July 2026), compared year-over-year.
method.threshold: A trend of ±15% YoY is Rising/Falling (needs ≥60 weighted points). Class weighting is explicit, not a black box.
method.note: Volume-based: dense areas naturally register more, so the year-over-year trend is the denominator-independent signal. Figures are computed facts from primary agency records; interpretation requires review. Climate/flood and compliance-deadline (LL97) risk are planned phase-2 additions.

narration.headline: Bronx carries the highest risk pressure — 104,932 severity-weighted hazardous-violation points in May 2026–July 2026 (22,333 immediately-hazardous, 37,933 hazardous), +2% year-over-year. Trend: Stable.
narration.citySummary: Citywide, 59,792 immediately-hazardous (Class C) and 100,886 hazardous (Class B) HPD violations were issued in May 2026–July 2026, +4% year-over-year, alongside 186,037 building complaints to 311 and $38M in new ECB penalty balances.
